references.observation: Arched glazed western approach, repeated portal ribs, dark floor, north low rails, opaque south base and handrail.
Diagonal western connection to straight central corridor; three northern viewing bays and eastern escalators. Schematic, not metric.

limits: Municipal faces 9/10 establish the coarse source footprint and floor plane; these are not surveyed finished dimensions.

The source bridge top is flat. A shallow arched enclosure is independently visible in the dated photograph; .55m rise, 1.3m target pitch and member sections are explicit authoring hypotheses pending camera registration.
The source 3m floor-to-top envelope is retained; actual glass curvature, fabrication details, clear width and material coefficients need refinement.
This component has open ends for integration with the separately registered restaurant approach and central Skyway; it does not prove public route continuity.
Three viewing bays in the official plan belong to the central corridor and are not included in this western bridge component.
Photographs and maps are research references only; no source image is embedded as a game texture.
